subject: Pre-audit readiness: control sampling window, evidence owners, and SLA carve-outs
messages:
From: Sara Brooks <sara.brooks@assurancy.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: fedcloud-procurement@fedcloud.gov
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pre-audit kickoff / sampling windows and SLA carve-outs

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the quick intro last week. We're starting to assemble the intake for Nemesis Financial's upcoming assessment (ISO + FedRAMP intake). To help us scope the pre-audit, can you confirm the following by EOD Friday: 

- Preferred control sampling window (we typically take a 7–10 day snapshot); any blackout periods to avoid?
- A mapped list of evidence owners (control owner, backup, and contact) for network, identity, logging, and encryption controls.
- Any known SLA exceptions or temporary carve-outs requested by the customer that would affect controls (we'll need documented approval).
- Where you prefer us to pull system snapshots / logs (S3 path, or will you upload a zip).

Also: please attach a current SIG/CAIQ mapping if available and an index of SOC 2 artifacts you intend to present. If helpful we can run a short 30-minute intake call early next week to go through the intake packet and schedule.

Best,
Sara Brooks
Senior Assessor, Assurancy
[sara.brooks@assurancy.com]

[attachment: pre-audit-intake-template.docx (docx, 86KB)]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sara Brooks <sara.brooks@assurancy.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-audit kickoff / sampling windows and SLA carve-outs

Sara — thanks, noted. Quick answers and a proposed plan: 

- Sampling window: proposal June 7–14. That avoids our maintenance window the week of June 1 and gives teams time to prepare. If you need earlier, we can compress to June 3–9 but we'll need to freeze changes in a couple of services.
- Evidence owners: attached a first-cut evidence index (evidence-index-20260527.xlsx). High level owners below:
  - Network controls: Diego Fernandez (owner) / Priya Natarajan (backup)
  - Identity & Access: Priya Natarajan (owner) / Mina Haddad (backup)
  - Logging & Monitoring: Mina Haddad (owner) / Diego Fernandez (backup)
  - Encryption & Key Mgmt: Diego Fernandez (owner) / Tessa Morgan (backup)

- SLA carve-outs: Nemesis has requested a temporary throughput SLA exception for batch ingest between May 30–June 6 — this is pending leadership approval. We'll flag any approved exceptions with signed attestations.

- System snapshots/logs: we'll upload consolidated archives to the shared Drive link you provided; for large log dumps we will place them in s3://redwood-audit/nemesis/2026-05 and share presigned URLs. I will attach a small sample of access logs now.

I'm copying the owners so they can confirm and fill gaps. Can we pencil in a 30-minute intake call on Thursday, June 3, 10:00–10:30 PT? If that works please send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Tessa
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

[attachment: evidence-index-20260527.xlsx (xlsx, 135KB)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Brooks <sara.brooks@assurancy.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-audit kickoff / sampling windows and SLA carve-outs

Confirming owners and a few open items from my side: 

- I will own logging & monitoring evidence. I will deliver the logging retention policy, alerting runbook, and three days of sample alerts/console exports before June 4.
- I attached control-owners-20260528.csv with direct phone + backup on-call rotation.
- Notes on SLA carve-out: the batch ingest exception impacts control CP-3 (capacity mgmt). This is operationally isolated but the evidence is an approved exception memo + leadership signature. We need Legal/FinOps sign-off — tagging Priya.

Open asks:
- Diego: can you confirm whether the HSM-backed KMS key rotation logs for April/May are in the access logs archive or separate? I want to ensure we include key rotation evidence for encryption controls.
- Priya: can you prepare a short attestation for the exception path if Leadership approves? A one-paragraph signed note should suffice for intake.

Thanks — I’ll stage the logging artifacts at the Drive link and notify Sara when uploads complete.

Mina
Sr. Security Engineer, Redwood Inference

[attachment: control-owners-20260528.csv (csv, 8KB)]

From: Sara Brooks <sara.brooks@assurancy.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-audit kickoff / sampling windows and SLA carve-outs

Thanks Tessa / Mina — this is very helpful. A couple follow-ups before we lock the window: 

- For FedRAMP scoping we will need system snapshots (AMI image ids or equivalent), transient host lists for the sampling window, and evidence of snapshot integrity (checksums). Please either provide presigned S3 URIs or upload a zip to the Drive link.
- On CAIQ: can you provide the latest CAIQ export (xlsx or csv) that maps control responses to the customer scoping? That will speed the mapping exercise.
- Regarding the SLA exception: if you can furnish the proposed attestation by EOD Monday we will accept that as provisional; final acceptance requires a signed leadership approval before the final report.

We still have capacity for a 30-minute intake call Thursday at 10:00 PT — I'll send a calendar invite to confirm.

Best,
Sara
Assurancy Audit Team

[Note: we'll request a separate secure upload for the HSM rotation logs if the archive is >100MB]

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Sara Brooks <sara.brooks@assurancy.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pre-audit kickoff / sampling windows and SLA carve-outs

All — thanks. Action items and commitments: 

- June 3 intake call confirmed (10:00–10:30 PT). Calendar link: https://calendar.redwood.com/meet/6c4f-pre-audit-call (invite sent).
- Upload plan:
  - Drive: evidence-index, CAIQ export (final), short attestation drafts (by EOD 6/2).
  - S3: full access logs + AMI snapshot manifests (presigned URIs to follow by 6/3 morning).
- Owners: Diego will stage KMS/HSM rotation logs into the S3 bucket (diego to confirm by EOD 6/2).
- Priya to draft the one-paragraph SLA exception attestation; target EOD 6/2 for provisional acceptance.

Attachments in this thread: Redwood_access_logs_202605.zip (sample), evidence-index-20260527.xlsx, control-owners-20260528.csv.

If anything changes we'll escalate, but this should get us to a clean sampling window.

Thanks team — see you on Thursday.

Tessa Morgan
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference
